REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL — RFP-2026-04

Issuing Organization: Acme Financial Services
Industry: Financial Services
Submission Deadline: 30 days from issuance

Background:
Acme Financial Services is undertaking a strategic review of our operations
and seeking external advisory support. We have grown 40% YoY for three
consecutive years but operational efficiency has declined.

Required Capabilities:
- Process re-engineering across customer onboarding
- AI/ML feasibility assessment for fraud detection
- Cost-to-serve analysis by customer segment
- Change management for technology adoption

Evaluation Criteria:
- Relevant case studies in financial services (40%)
- Methodology fit (30%)
- Team experience (20%)
- Commercial terms (10%)

Timeline:
Engagement to commence within 4 weeks of contract signature.
Initial findings expected within 8 weeks.
